entities.name: Worzel
entities.description: One of the first named planeswalkers in Magic's story, a human who weaves leylines into braids and casts spells from them; Thomil's rival.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: Planeswalker and Worzel's rival, who uses red and black magic with dragons, sea serpents, zombies and demons.

entities.name: Roreca
entities.description: Worzel's companion who helps her locate leylines.

entities.name: Richard Garfield
entities.description: Magic's creator, who wrote the first stories.

entities.name: Eumenes
entities.description: A Hurloon minotaur summoned by a rival of Thomil, possibly Worzel's.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: A demon summoned by Thomil that ate a man-thing and attacked Worzel, then turned on Thomil.

entities.name: Ergamon
entities.description: Plane where Worzel and Thomil dueled, containing the Truga Jungle.

entities.name: Truga Jungle
entities.description: Area of Ergamon where Worzel sought leylines.

entities.name: Cabralin
entities.description: Place Worzel visited and returned to.

entities.name: Glasses of Urza
entities.description: Artifact Worzel offered a white-magic wizard as payment.

events.summary: After losing to Thomil's red magic and dragons, Worzel seeks a white-magic wizard, offers the Glasses of Urza, and coerces him by winning a duel, letting him keep the artifact.
events.quote: She coerced this wizard into instructing her by defeating him in a duel

events.summary: Thomil challenges Worzel again; she stalls with green minions while Thomil surprisingly summons zombies; the outcome is unknown.
events.quote: The outcome of the battle is unknown.

events.summary: Worzel befriends Roreca, who watches her duels and helps her find leylines.

Worzel planeswalks to Ergamon, detects Thomil, and duels him with braided leylines, summoning sprites and bears and casting lightning; Thomil answers with black magic and zombies; she stalls with a blue storm.
events.quote: used a red leyline to evoke lightning bolts against Thomil

events.summary: Thomil summons a Lord of the Pit; Worzel finally finds a white leyline and casts Circle of Protection: Black, withstanding the demon.
events.quote: Finally, with a white leyline, Worzel cast a Circle of Protection: Black

events.summary: The Lord of the Pit turns on Thomil, who flees the plane; Worzel planeswalks back to Cabralin with Roreca.
events.quote: He fled the plane, and his summoned demon vanished after raging around the plane for a time.

relations.quote: Worzel was a planeswalker who dueled Thomil often
Worzel traveled with her companion Roreca , who helped her locate leylines .
Thomil summoned a Lord of the Pit and a "man-thing" as a sacrifice to the demon
